title: NEL 2.5
text: 5–15 game seasons; choose position and complete daily team ladder quests. Bench → Starter → World-Class Talent → Team Emperor. Complete quests twice to advance; switching teams restarts them.

title: NEL 2.0
text: Position stat multipliers: striker shooting/dribble, midfielder passing/assists, defender steals/saves. Career offers based on S–D stats across five categories. Goals/steals/assists/saves, not passes, drive ranking.

title: NEL evolutions
text: NEL Nagi and NEL Isagi questlines and NEL wheel introduced. Their reworks were still upcoming in this announcement.
